meta.name: backlink-analyzer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "analyze backlinks" or "外链分析"; profiles external referring domains, anchor-text distribution, toxic links, and competitor link gaps. Not for internal links — use internal-linking-optimizer. 外链分析/反向链接

copy.tagline: 分析外链分布与质量，发现竞争对手链接缺口
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做网站SEO，需要了解外链状况并找到改进机会。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze backlink profiles and discover competitor link gaps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing SEO and need to understand your backlink profile and find opportunities.

howto.what: 分析指定域名的外链质量，包括来源域名、锚文本分布、毒性链接和竞争对手的链接差距，并生成带来源标签的报告。
howto.when: 当用户要求“分析外链”或“外链分析”时触发。

say.text: 分析 example.com 的外链质量。
say.note: 生成外链概况和毒性链接报告。

say.text: 对比 example.com 和 competitor.com 的链接差距。

howto.what_en: Analyzes backlink profiles for a given domain, covering referring domains, anchor-text distribution, toxic links, and competitor link gaps, outputting a source-tagged report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "analyze backlinks" or "外链分析".

say_en.note: Generates a backlink overview and toxic link report.

say_en.text: Find link building opportunities by analyzing competitor domains.
